identitySignals: The agenda name "Amethod Public Schools - Oakland Charter High School" matches the registered nonprofit Amethod Public Schools (EIN 94-3185735, ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer and GuideStar). Its listed NTEE category is Charter Schools.

Wikipedia says Amethod Public Schools operates Oakland Charter High School (2433 Coolidge Ave, Oakland, in the Oakland Unified School District area). This matches the agenda item, which is a charter-school governance notice from OUSD's Office of Charter Schools.
The organization has an Oakland connection. Wikipedia describes it as based in Oakland, and a payment address of 2101 Livingston St, Oakland, appears on GuideStar.
Public board minutes from Amethod Public Schools and the organization's own Contact page give the same Richmond administrative office and phone number as GuideStar.

Per Wikipedia, Oakland Charter High School closed in June 2025.

profile.summary: Amethod Public Schools is a nonprofit that runs public charter schools in Oakland and Richmond, California. It started in 1993 with Oakland Charter Academy. Its schools serve students from elementary through high school grades.
